The U.S. Army opened permanent anti-drone test lanes in Arizona, signaling a significant expansion of counter-UAS infrastructure and procurement [U.S. Army opened permanent test lanes](https://news.google.?oc=5). To support these efforts, companies including Echodyne, Smart Shooter, and Fortem secured substantial funding or contracts. Additionally, the Pentagon named figures to lead a study on the future of warfare to integrate autonomous systems and AI.

Local governments are increasing scrutiny of autonomous vehicle deployments. The Minneapolis City Council passed an ordinance requiring human drivers in driverless vehicles [Minneapolis passed an ordinance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5). Simultaneously, several U.S. states challenged the Federal Aviation Administration environmental review regarding commercial drone package rules [US States Challenge FAA Environmental Review](https://www.uasvision.com/2026/10/02/us-states-challenge-faa-environmental-review-of-commercial-drone-package-rules/).

Industrial robotics is seeing a trend of expansion through strategic partnerships and private investment. Agility Robotics appointed 3 new board members ahead of a public debut [Agility Robotics taps 3 new board members](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNSjVLODFXZ1ZReHA0NU9RR0ptRDBqc0tvRmVXMU0wSE5YU25DMTgycjZlQ1ZYRFVtaGF0b0VuSy1fMi1keTJYUXZkWGM4VEM0ek8yazNvY0F1YUk2UUZ5VGI0dGNyOEFnNjdZempLcmltNFRsTE9uRzF6cEFSakFPSjBGdkNtbGdpZkVyZw?oc=5), while Hitachi and Fanuc formed a partnership for physical AI in manufacturing. Other developments include Amazon expanding robotics manufacturing in Indiana and Hyundai preparing the Atlas robot for factory use.

In federal policy and transport, the Federal Aviation Administration certified the Garmin Autoland system for the Epic E1000 AX turboprop [FAA Certifies Garmin Autoland](https://generalaviationnews.com/2026/10/01/faa-certifies-garmin-autoland-on-epic-e1000-ax/). NASA awarded $1.4 billion in logistics support service agreements to 16 companies to streamline resource management and operational costs. In rail, Amtrak introduced new Airo trainsets on the Cascades route.
